blocks.text: This page is the shortest practical route into Calculator. It intentionally avoids a giant shopping list because recipes, power costs and research requirements can be changed by the server or pack.

rows: Craft the Calculator using the live recipe below. Keep the Field Guide nearby: the same item can always bring you back to these instructions.
Make or connect a basic power source. The Hand-Cranked Generator is the built-in early option; an external FE source also works when its route is enabled.
Place a Power Cube if you want a visible energy buffer between generation and machines. Set its sides so energy enters from the source and exits toward the machine.
Craft an Extraction Chamber. Feed it a valid early input such as the recipe list shows, supply the full batch energy, and leave output space.
When you get Dirty or Damaged circuit material, do not put it directly into Analysis. Restore Dirty chips, Reassemble Damaged chips, then Analyse clean boards.
Build a Research Chamber when a recipe says it is locked. Study the required sample; the guide can show your current research snapshot but reading the page does not unlock it.
After one manual batch works, configure item sides and automation. Test one connection at a time before adding Transfer Upgrades or a large pipe network.
